channel.title: UXID Lab news
channel.description: News from the UXID Lab (User Experience and Interaction Design) at Ontario Tech University.

item.title: Causal Health Agent accepted at IEEE BigData 2026
item.description: Farnaz's paper Causal Health Agent: From Wearable Sensor Anomalies to Evidence-Grounded Explanations, with Heidar Davoudi, has been accepted at the 9th Special Session on Healthcare Data of the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Big Data (IEEE BigData 2026) in Phoenix, Arizona, 14-17 December 2026.

item.title: CoRead presented at ICMI 2026 in Napoli, Italy
item.description: Sakil Sarker presented our full paper CoRead: Using Implicit Behavioural Signals for Mixed-Initiative AI Support in Collaborative Academic Reading at the 28th ACM International Conference on Multimodal Interaction (ICMI 2026) in Napoli, Italy, 5-9 October 2026.

item.title: Two poster papers accepted at UIST 2026
item.description: CiteLen: In-Situ Multi-Lens Citation Analysis for Scholarly Reading, and CTATutor: From Instructor-Guided Computational Thinking Blueprints to Adaptive Algorithm Tutoring, were accepted as posters at UIST 2026 in Detroit. Congratulations to Yasaman and Zeyuan.

item.title: RIDGE accepted for oral presentation at IEEE CoG 2026
item.description: RIDGE: State-Conditioned Reward Blending for Behavioral Coverage in Deep RL Game Agents was accepted for oral presentation at the IEEE Conference on Games 2026 in Madrid, Spain. Congratulations to Al Muqshith Mohammed Shifan and Kevin Christopher Chua.

item.title: Yasaman Basti defends her MSc thesis
item.description: Yasaman Basti successfully defended her MSc thesis, CiteView: In-Situ Citation Sensemaking for Scholarly Reading, becoming the second graduate student from the UXID Lab to complete her degree this summer.

item.title: Sakil Sarker defends his MSc thesis
item.description: Sakil Sarker successfully defended his MSc thesis, the first graduate student from the UXID Lab to complete his degree. His thesis has been nominated for the Best Thesis Award.

item.title: CoRead accepted at ICMI 2026
item.description: CoRead: Using Implicit Behavioural Signals for Mixed-Initiative AI Support in Collaborative Academic Reading was accepted at ICMI 2026 in Italy.

item.title: Earable swipe gestures presented at Graphics Interface 2026
item.description: Shimon presented Exploring Above-Neck Unimanual Swipe Gestures for Off-Device Earable Interaction at Graphics Interface 2026 in Kitchener-Waterloo, Ontario.

item.title: Best Undergraduate Thesis Award for the third year running
item.description: For the third year in a row a UXID Lab student has received the Best Undergraduate Thesis Award. Congratulations to Alyesha Singh, Kershan Arulneswaran, Rania Rejdal and Alex Lowe on successfully defending their theses.
